baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun at word 2 is the elevated overhead sky, and the intransitive verb at word 3 predicates its opening or splitting.
baseline_models.mechanism: A continuous upper cover develops a breach. The event is therefore a failure of enclosure and shelter, not merely motion somewhere in the sky.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies an elevated overhead cover, functioning as the enclosing material whose continuity is lost.
The branch supplies opening, cracking, and visible fissure, functioning as the mode by which the cover fails.

changed_reading.before: The sky undergoes an unspecified catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: The sheltering upper cover loses continuity and becomes an opening, so the ayah stages the failure of cosmic enclosure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 3 carries both the branch of rupture and a distinct branch of bringing something into being, while word 2 names the high created order affected.
baseline_models.mechanism: The rupture can be carried as a threshold between orders: the stable high arrangement is opened through the same root that can image origination. This does not erase the crack; it lets destruction and renewed beginning coexist.

changed_reading.before: The split only terminates an existing sky.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping attached to the sky root at word 2 includes marks read as signs, and word 3 includes visible fissures.
baseline_models.mechanism: The crack alters the sky from background into evidence. Its changed surface is not only damaged but readable: the condition of the upper order becomes publicly marked.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah couples the opened cover with its formerly ordered visible contents being cast apart. This activates a container-and-contents reading in which loss of enclosure and loss of arrangement are two scales of one failure.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an opened sky followed by dispersed stars; I infer a container-to-contents coupling and a possible arrow from failed enclosure to scattering. A live alternative is that both are coordinated effects with no causal direction between them.

changed_reading.before: The sky cracks as an isolated object.
changed_reading.after: The sky's opening initiates or displays a systemic de-coherence in which the containing order and its luminous contents come apart together.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wide waters below are then opened with force, mirroring the breach above. The focus rupture expands into a vertically distributed loss of containment rather than a defect confined to one altitude.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies homologous openings above and below; I infer either a cascading breach or a shared pressure regime across levels. The live alternative is a rhetorical series of independent upheavals rather than one physical system.

changed_reading.before: Only the upper surface is torn.
changed_reading.after: The upper tear is the first visible instance of a world-wide failure of boundaries, mirrored by the forced opening of the seas.

context_deltas.mechanism: The graves supply a concealed low interior, and their overturning exposes what was covered by turning the arrangement through itself. The sky's opening is thus revised from mere breakage into the first instance of an inside becoming outside.

strongest_changes: The isolated crack became a container-and-contents failure when the stars were dispersed.
The sequence through overturned graves and resulting knowledge changed rupture into universal disclosure and readable accounting.
The creation and composition sequence made destruction coexist with contingency, de-composition, and possible renewed ordering.
The final loss of possession changed physical rupture into a material analogue for revoked derivative agency and sole divine authority.
summary.what_was_special: The focus root pair supports several simultaneous mechanisms: breached shelter, origination reopened, readable mark, unsealed record, differentiating threshold, and collapse of delegated cohesion. The split mappings were especially productive when contained as activators rather than mistaken for direct glosses.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet orders the events but does not decide whether sky, stars, seas, and graves form a causal cascade or parallel effects.
The origination branch permits a renewed-order reading, but the direction from rupture to re-creation is reader-supplied rather than stated.
The marked-season, stopper, and outpouring readings depend on form-distant mapped roots and should remain exploratory analogies.
The record, threshold, and sovereignty models may be retrospective activations rather than mechanisms intrinsic to the focus clause alone.
